32 weeks and 6 days = 32*7 + 6 = 224 + 6 = 230 days.  
Add 230 days: March has 31 days, so from March 18: 31 - 18 = 13 days into March, leaving 230 - 13 = 217 days left.  
April (30), May (31), June (30), July (31), August (31), September (30) = 183 days total, leaving 217 - 183 = 34 days into October.  
October 1 + 33 days = October 34 → November 3, 1387.
